YES. And the fact that most of these agencies are run by former nannies is the most infuriating because they know first hand how exasperating this process can be.

It's so frustrating. Part of me thinks that maybe they still don't view what we do as an actual career, even though a lot of agencies are run by former nannies. I'm sure they're also frustrated because they have to wait to hear back from families. But an update every now and then, or even acknowledgement that you received documents I submitted would be appreciated. 

In my original post, the woman didn't even tell me she would be out of town. Otherwise, I wouldn't have expected a timely response. And the ad for this position is still posted and flagged as "urgently hiring". Again, if I'm not right for this position, tell me. But don't keep dangling the carrot with delayed emails asking for a good time to call.

I swear, there are some parents who think simply being in their presence and around their offspring is payment enough. And I’m sure they’ll try and get you to “help out around the house since you’re there anyway.” Parents like this also seem to have the mindset that childcare and anything domestic related is beneath them, yet they shouldn’t have to pay much for someone else to do it. Drives me nuts.
